article.headline: Evander stunner helps Cincinnati beat D.C. United
article.description: Evander had a goal and an assist, Tom Barlow also scored and Cincinnati beat D.C. United 2-0 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Evander stunner helps Cincinnati beat D.C. United
article.story:
WASHINGTON -- - Evander had a goal and an assist, Tom Barlow also scored and Cincinnati beat D.C. United 2-0 on Saturday night.

Cincinnati (11-11-9), which also beat D.C. United 2-1 on Wednesday in a rescheduled game, moved into a tie for seventh place in the Eastern Conference with Orlando.

United (7-12-12) has lost three straight games.

Evander opened the scoring in the 35th minute when he rocketed a shot from distance. Barlow slotted home a pass from Evander in the 52nd.

Cincinnati recorded its third clean sheet of the season - and first since April 25.

It was the seventh time since 2022 that MLS teams played back-to-back matches against each other - and the second for Cincinnati.

Up next Cincinnati: Plays at Miami on Wednesday.

D.C. United: Plays at Toronto on Wednesday.
